title: Replying to a hub notification email posts the reply into the thread it came from

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-24: signed reply addresses and the inbound router work for comms conversations only; a reply to a Plan comment or mention email bounces into nothing. Owner ruling 2026-11-24: email is the only outside channel for now (no Slack or WhatsApp). Fix: encode the item thread in the reply token, strip quoted text, post as the sender. Inbound mail counts against the Resend quota, so it goes through the daily quota valve.

A tag email carries Reply-To reply+n<notice id>-<HMAC>@reply domain; lib/comms/inbound.ts verifies it and lib/comms/thread-reply.ts posts the reply's new words (quoted trail cut) into the Plan, item thread or room as the notice's recipient, only while they still belong there; redeliveries within 10 minutes are not posted twice. No SQL.
